name: realm-bench-ReactTGV
description: Part of the realm-bench suite; ReactTGV is a text-focused evaluation set intended to measure language models' ability to produce correct, grounded text responses given prompts in the ReactTGV subset. It contains prompt-response pairs used to assess generative and reasoning behavior under the realm-bench evaluation protocols.
reputation: A niche subset within the realm-bench collection with limited but growing use in community evaluations.
